notes.title: Battlecore Robots – September Update for Patreon
notes.notes: [p]September's update just landed — New version of Battlecore Robots on Patreon![/p][p][/p][p][b]September adds 8 new chips and 4 new mapas![/b][/p][p][/p][p]New Chips[/p][list][*][p]Frenetic Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Spectral Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Hanzo's Echoes[/p][/*][*][p]Repulsor Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Charger Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Wildfist Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Watchdog Chip[/p][/*][*][p]Cooler Chip[/p][/*][/list][p]New Maps[/p][list][*][p]Training Arena Blue (Rework)[/p][/*][*][p]Ruins[/p][/*][*][p]Workzone[/p][/*][*][p]Spiky Platform[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These [b]new chips[/b] add greater customization capabilities, allowing you to alter stats without having to change the rest of your build. Do you love that Gun but wish it wouldn't overheat so quickly? There might be a chip for that![/p][p]And that's not all: we're also experimenting with [b]4[/b] [b]new maps[/b] (including a rework of [i]Training Arena Blue[/i]) to refine the experience and deliver more fun and varied combat. We'll show you more soon![/p][p]Furthermore, we've added base game improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Added Antialiasing (FAA)[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented improvements to the AI[/p][/*][*][p]Better shader loading performance[/p][/*][/list][p]In the future, we will give you the option to change the type of Antialiasing you want to apply. In the meantime, we have implemented this visual improvement to make the wait more pleasant.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WA8oev9mxTU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]THANK YOU SO MUCH[/b] for your support on Patreon. It means the world to us — it’s what keeps the project alive and growing.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re enjoying Battlecore Robots and want to help build its future (and get early access to new versions, behind-the-scenes content, and more), consider joining our Patreon:[/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/battlecorerobots"]https://www.patreon.com/battlecorerobots[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts on the new content—share feedback, ideas, and epic plays in the comments or on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Arena![/p][p][/p][p][i]— The YellowFall Games team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Battlecore Robots – June Patreon Update Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! New month, new update for Battlecore Robots on Patreon!

[b]June brings four brand-new parts![/b] 
[list]
[*]Bomb - Akira 
[*]Bomb - Illegal Subzero 
[*]Pod - Portal 
[*]Pod - Illegal Repulsor 
[/list]
[b]A CPU build customization system[/b], so you can edit the CPU’s loadout to your liking!

[previewyoutube=xyXFg1qFFxg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy the new content. We’d love to hear your thoughts! 

We also want to give a huge thanks to all our Patrons who’ve supported us since day one. It means the world to us and fuels us to keep pushing the project forward. From the bottom of our hearts, [b]thank you so much![/b]

See you in the Arena!

[i]The YellowFall Games Team[/i]
